inputLines: I challenged their shark to poker.
I taught the octopus insider trading.
Our lawyers would like another hand.
preparation: Writer B contributed a setup before Writer A’s clip began.
edit: Writer A’s flow followed by Writer B’s overlapping live-return view from the same run. No generated application frames or model outputs.
steps: A shakes the bottle to start a round
A shakes the bottle to catch B’s setup
A unfolds the note over the sea
A downloads the real postcard image
B opens the live returned postcard
B reads the same canonical postcard
imageCredits: See docs/asset-sources.md and the in-app Image credits page for human-made photographic sources and licenses.
motion: Native water ripples under a fixed horizon and one continuous creased paper mesh. The recording captures the actual browser rendering.
